config.claim_boundary: This is retrospective historical as-of rolling-origin evidence. Every fold refits/selects its causal base using only data available before that fold, then uses a pre-score adaptation warm-up. The v0.27 structure itself was designed later, so these rows are robustness/backtest evidence, not live forward evidence and not an untouched confirmatory validation set.

source_transition_rule: Union legacy and current forecasts; at identical target/publication timestamps prefer current, then select the latest publication actually available by each decision time.
